report:
# Cabello frame-polytope census

The old Lean arithmetic/incidence census is not a vertex-enumeration proof. This run exhausts every nine-column incidence basis and independently recomputes the census with integer Bareiss/Cramer determinants. Every actual rational symmetric representative is checked on all 18 rays and has an explicit negative integer quadratic witness. Spectral classes use exact shifted semidefinite/definite predicates, never floating eigenvalues. Generated Lean data are tied to the numerical certificates and checked as finite integer equations. The bridge to a general formal real-polytope vertex theorem and general PSD/spectral transport remains open.
